rejections.reason: Windows Ghidra P0 accepts native PE and explicitly selected raw 6502 targets only.
Hopper integration is not supported on win32.
Headerless raw-binary analysis requires the Ghidra adapter with a caller-supplied architecture and entry point.
Set REA_IDA_MCP_CONFIG to an upstream IDA MCP JSON registration; see docs/ida-provider.md.
IDA does not admit headerless raw binaries. Open the target with Ghidra and supply architecture and entry_point.
Set REA_KUNA_COMMAND to the absolute path of a caller-supplied kuna executable (verified with 1.833). REA does not download, install or update Kuna.
REA verified the Kuna provider on ELF and thin Mach-O images; raw-binary is not admitted yet.
